message.reasoning:
I am ready to play Monopoly.

I have $30 and almost no unmortgaged properties. p3 has a massive empire with hotels on nearly everything. I am considering trading with p3 or mortgaging MARVIN_GARDENS.

I am weighing trade offers to p3. I have two jail cards and no unmortgaged properties to mortgage. I am trying to find something p3 would want.

I have the orange and dark blue monopolies. p3 has the light blues, pinks, greens, and all railroads. The red monopoly is split between us.

Trading reds or dark blues to p3 would complete their monopolies and accelerate my defeat. Jail cards are useless against their massive cash pile.

I cannot build on mortgaged properties, so I have no way to strengthen my position. p3 has no incentive to trade with me because they inherit everything if I go bankrupt. I am now calculating the rent on Marvin Gardens.

I will end my turn. I am not mortgaging Marvin Gardens because it is my only source of income. I am not trading with p3 because they will not pay meaningful cash for my assets.

I cannot unmortgage any properties right now. The cash I have is far below the cost of un-mortgaging even one property.

Unmortgaging even the cheapest property costs $33, so I cannot restore any holdings. The probability of surviving this turn is effectively zero. I will keep my two get-out-of-jail cards as a future safeguard if I am sent to jail.
